'''2011 German National Championship Floris de Vries DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Floris de Vries]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)|VB2-D-imperialoccupation-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Speed Walkers
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
